First, convert 21 weeks and 1 day to days:  
21 weeks = 21 × 7 = 147 days, plus 1 day = 148 days.  

Subtract 148 days from 1404-08-26:  
August 26, 1404 minus 148 days.  

Go back 26 days to August 1 → 31 days in July → 30 in June → 31 in May → 30 in April → 20 more days into March.  
148 total days: 26 (Aug) + 31 (Jul) + 30 (Jun) + 31 (May) + 30 (Apr) = 148 days exactly.  

So 148 days before August 26 is March 31, 1404.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1404-03-31
